verdict.rationale: DBOS documents a durable streaming feature that streams agent output as it is generated, and readers keep receiving values across server restarts. That covers the core of streaming live output from a running workflow. Evidence is thin on getting that stream into a frontend, and there is no hands-on corroboration. Missing for 10: documented frontend delivery path (e.g. SSE/WebSocket or HTTP streaming endpoint), explicit token-level and step-progress streaming examples, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I stream live progress — step updates or model tokens — from a running workflow into my frontend as it executes

citations.quote: Durable streaming: Stream output from your agents as it's generated to build interactive or conversational flows that recover from any failure.
Every write is persisted, so if a server restarts mid-response the workflow recovers from where it left off and the reader keeps receiving values without dropping output.
